text:
Good morning desk staff,
Clear signage came up earlier this week, so just a quick note

Please treat every handoff as urgent and keep the desk clear of any mixed messages. We are still seeing travelers arrive with incomplete pet details, and that slows service at the counter and in the lounge. Safety comes first on every journey, so check the carrier, the paperwork, and the animal's condition before you move anyone forward.

For Thornwick cases, keep the processing notes tight and send any concern straight to the senior coordinator. <<FACT F010>> If a traveler looks unsure, stay calm, speak plainly, and walk them through the required steps without delay. We cannot afford confusion at intake, especially when the pet is already stressed.

The lounge team also needs prompt updates whenever there is a change in arrival status or care needs. <<FACT F002>> If you are covering a transfer or a handoff, confirm the carrier latch, the label, and the owner details before release. For quarantine concerns, do not improvise; escalate at once, document the issue, and keep the pet separated until the review is complete. <<FACT F028>> This is a service desk, but it is also a safety point, so every check must be consistent and every message must be clear.

Thank you for staying sharp and moving quickly with care. Please keep the standard high and report any gap immediately.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
